hero.title: Your purchasing, from requisition to payment.
hero.subtitle: procureApp digitizes the entire procure-to-pay cycle: requests, approvals, tenders, purchase orders, receipts, invoices and payments — in one fully traceable tool.

features.title: Everything you need to run procurement
features.subtitle: Built for procurement, finance, logistics and management teams.

items.title: Requisitions
items.desc: Create requests with items, budget lines and Excel/CSV import.

items.title: Approval workflows
items.desc: Multi-level approval based on amount: manager, finance, general management.

items.title: Tenders
items.desc: Publishing, sealed bids until closing, comparison and award.

items.title: Purchase orders
items.desc: POs generated, approved and automatically sent to suppliers as PDF.

items.title: 3-way matching
items.desc: Automatic check of purchase order + goods receipt + invoice before payment.

items.title: Dashboards
items.desc: Budget tracking, request progress and pending tasks by role.

items.title: Real-time notifications
items.desc: In-app and email alerts at every workflow step.

items.title: PDF & Excel exports
items.desc: Official documents with your branding, in French or English.

cycle.title: A complete procure-to-pay cycle
cycle.subtitle: Every step is orchestrated by a workflow engine: an invoice cannot be paid before goods are received.

suppliers.title: A dedicated supplier portal
suppliers.subtitle: Suppliers register online, upload their documents and respond to tenders from every company on the platform.

Browse open tenders and submit bids online
